biggest_catch: Pay arrives about 60 days after the end of the shop month — the slowest payout cycle in this lane — and most shops require an out-of-pocket purchase you float until reimbursement.
catches: PayPal payment posts around 60 days after the last day of the shop month (end of following month after client acceptance).
